goal: Breite eines Draft-Elements im festen 12-Spalten-Raster in genau zwei abhaengigen Schritten ausschliesslich browserlokal aenderbar machen. Schritt 1 fuegt ein Breiten-Control 1 bis 12 hinzu und validiert column + width vor jeder Mutation. Schritt 2 darf erst nach gruenem Zwischen-Gate Fokus-Rueckgabe, Tastatur-/Narrow-Semantik und Preview-Konsistenz haerten. Keine Persistenz, kein Domain-/Store-Vertrag und kein Frozen-Core-Reopen.

guide_delta.summary: Schritt 1 erlaubt Breiten von 1 bis 12 Spalten, aber nur wenn das Element an seiner aktuellen Startspalte vollständig im Raster bleibt. Ungültige Breiten werden vor der Draft-Mutation abgewiesen.

direct_dependencies: placementFitsGrid(column, width) is the existing browser-local 12-column boundary contract
persistent LayoutBox width contract remains untouched
tests_required: Step 1: compile browser shell and focused browser regression
Step 1: width choices are deterministic integers 1 through 12
Step 1: widths that overflow from current column are disabled
Step 1: placementFitsGrid guard executes before item.width mutation
Step 1: invalid width leaves draft width and all unrelated properties unchanged
Step 1: valid width rerenders canvas and preview from the same item.width
Step 1: width change has no persistence or domain dependency
Step 2 only after green: successful width change restores focus to the same width control
Step 2 only after green: width label/control and status remain keyboard reachable and narrow-layout safe
Step 2 only after green: preview and move target availability remain consistent after resize
GET-only, loopback-only and no-persistence contracts remain unchanged
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because scope is limited to browser mask-builder width
database/repository tests because no persistent path changes
MaskTemplate store tests because width edits are not persisted
risks: width mutation must never allow column + width beyond 12
invalid selection must not mutate draft identity or layout
preview and canvas must read the same width value
Step 2 focus must target the same draft identity after rerender
non_changes: no domain LayoutBox, MaskElement, repository or store changes
no database, SQL, service or MaskTemplateStore changes
no README or TODO mutation in I118
expected_side_effects: draft element width can change between 1 and the remaining grid columns
invalid widths are rejected before mutation
canvas and preview update from the accepted width
reload still discards temporary width changes
